items.name: Shortbow
items.description: This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by skirmishers and cavalry.

items.name: Spiked Gauntlet
items.description: Providing the same defensive function as a standard gauntlet, this version has a group of spikes protruding from the knuckles.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Brawler Critical Specialization
offensiveAbilities.description: When the orc spinecracker gets a critical hit with a brawling weapon, the target must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Slowed 1 until the end of the spinecracker's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Combat Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The spinecracker has one hand free, and their target is within reach of that hand

Effect Using their prior attack to shift their opponent's guard, the spinecracker makes a melee Strike with one hand. If it hits, they grab the target using their other hand. The creature remains Grabbed until the end of the spinecracker's next turn or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Pin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The spinecracker has a creature Grappled

Effect The spinecracker crushes the creature in their grip, dealing (2d6+6) Bludgeoning Damage damage and giving the target the Restrained condition until the end of the spinecracker's next turn.
